name: Personal Dotfiles
description: Clone and apply personal dotfiles from a Git repository

repository.description: Git repository URL containing your dotfiles (e.g., https://github.com/username/dotfiles.git)

targetPath.description: Path where dotfiles repository will be cloned

installScript.description: Name of the install script to run (relative to repository root)

backupExisting.description: Backup existing dotfiles before replacing them
